text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 53 पर मोटरबाइक का पंक्चर ठीक करने का फ़्लो चार्ट पढ़ो। तीर क्रम बताते हैं।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 53 par motorbike ka puncture theek karne ka flow chart padho. Teer kram bataate hain.
text.en: Read the flow chart for repairing a motorbike puncture on page 53 of your book. The arrows show the order.

steps.question: What do you do if there is a fault in the valve?

questionMeaning.hi: वाल्व ख़राब हो तो क्या करें?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Valve kharaab ho to kya karein?

steps.modelAnswer: If there is a fault in the valve, we replace it.

modelMeaning.hi: अगर वाल्व ख़राब हो, तो उसे बदल देते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Agar valve kharaab ho, to use badal dete hain.

steps.question: What do you do after removing the wheel?

questionMeaning.hi: पहिया निकालने के बाद क्या करें?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Pahiya nikaalne ke baad kya karein?

options: Remove the tube from the tyre.
steps.answer: Remove the tube from the tyre.
steps.modelAnswer: After removing the wheel, we remove the tube from the tyre.

modelMeaning.hi: पहिया निकालने के बाद टायर से ट्यूब निकालते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Pahiya nikaalne ke baad tyre se tube nikaalte hain.

steps.question: How do you check the tube for leakage?
options: Pump air into it, put it in water and look for bubbles.
steps.answer: Pump air into it, put it in water and look for bubbles.
steps.modelAnswer: We pump air into the tube, put it in water and check for leakage (bubbles come out of the hole).

modelMeaning.hi: ट्यूब में हवा भरकर उसे पानी में डालते हैं; जहाँ से बुलबुले निकलें, वहाँ छेद है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Tube mein hawa bharkar use paani mein daalte hain; jahan se bulbule niklein, wahan chhed hai.

steps.question: What do you do after you have found the leakage?

questionMeaning.hi: छेद मिलने के बाद क्या करें?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Chhed milne ke baad kya karein?

options: Mark the place of leakage and take the tube out.
steps.answer: Mark the place of leakage and take the tube out.
steps.modelAnswer: After finding the leakage, we mark the place and take the tube out of the water.

modelMeaning.hi: छेद मिलने पर उस जगह निशान लगाकर ट्यूब पानी से बाहर निकालते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Chhed milne par us jagah nishaan lagaakar tube paani se baahar nikaalte hain.

steps.question: How do you repair the puncture?
options: with puncture solution and a piece of rubber
steps.answer: with puncture solution and a piece of rubber
steps.modelAnswer: We repair the tube with puncture solution and a piece of rubber. Then we fit the wheel in the bike.

modelMeaning.hi: ट्यूब को पंक्चर सॉल्यूशन और रबर के टुकड़े से ठीक करते हैं। फिर पहिया बाइक में लगा देते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Tube ko puncture solution aur rubber ke tukde se theek karte hain. Phir pahiya bike mein laga dete hain.
